description: This file declares an interface IWarningReportingMedia for warning reporting media within the WPEFramework's WarningReporting namespace. It includes a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method Output for reporting warning events.

classes.name: IWarningReportingMedia
classes.description: An interface for warning reporting media that defines a method for outputting warning information.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs warning event information, including filename, line number, class name, and warning details.
